n854adabe590.s: Which of the following pairs relating to the Special Assistance Package for Andhra Pradesh is correctly matched?
o: Section 94(1) – Polavaram as a national project
Section 90 – Polavaram as a national project
n854adabe590.x: Polavaram was treated as a national project under Section 90, while Section 94(1) covers industrial incentives and has nothing to do with Polavaram.

new.s: The Union Cabinet approved the Special Assistance Package for Andhra Pradesh on:
new.x: The package was announced in September 2016 and approved by the Union Cabinet on 15 March 2017.

new.s: Who gave the 2014 Rajya Sabha assurance of Special Category Status to Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: Manmohan Singh gave the SCS assurance in the Rajya Sabha in 2014; Arun Jaitley later announced the package in its place.

new.s: Which of the following pairs under the AP Reorganisation Act provisions of the package is correctly matched?
o: Section 46(2) – Backward areas of Rayalaseema and North Coastal AP
new.x: Section 46(2) covers the backward areas of Rayalaseema and North Coastal AP; Sec 90 is Polavaram and Sec 94(1) is tax incentives.

new.s: Under the package, the Centre bears what share of the Polavaram irrigation-component cost from 1 April 2014?
new.x: As a national project under Section 90, Polavaram's irrigation-component cost is borne 100% by the Centre from 1 April 2014.

new.s: How much was promised to Andhra Pradesh for the capital under the Special Assistance Package?
new.x: Rs 2,500 crore was promised for the capital; Rs 3,979 crore was the 2014-15 revenue deficit grant.

new.s: In January 2018, the AP Chief Minister asked for the EAP money to be routed as a grant through:
new.x: In January 2018 the CM sought the money as a grant through NABARD instead of external loans.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Externally Aided Projects route for Andhra Pradesh:
1. AP borrows from agencies such as the World Bank and ADB.
2. The Centre repays the loan and interest up to the SCS-equivalent 40% share.
3. It covers EAPs signed and disbursed in 2015-16 to 2019-20.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: AP borrows from the World Bank, ADB etc. and the route covers EAPs of 2015-16 to 2019-20; the SCS-equivalent share is 90%, not 40%.

new.s: Under Special Category Status, Centrally Sponsored Scheme funds could be used for:
new.x: SCS funds could be used across all schemes, while package funds were tied to approved EAPs.

new.s: The Centre's 'domino fear' over SCS for AP referred to identical demands from:
new.x: The Centre feared identical SCS demands from Bihar and Odisha.

new.s: The 14th Finance Commission raised the States' share in central tax devolution to:
new.x: The 14th FC raised devolution to 42% and removed the general-special distinction, which the Centre said covered SCS benefits.

new.s: Which party called the Special Assistance Package a 'betrayal' and made SCS its 2019 campaign plank?
new.x: YSRCP called the package a betrayal and made SCS its 2019 campaign plank.

new.s: AP's revenue deficit, Rs 16,000 crore in 2014-19, is projected for 2025-26 at:
new.x: AP's revenue deficit is projected to rise to Rs 48,000 crore in 2025-26; Rs 38,000 crore is the loss cited by the FM.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about AP Government stands on SCS?
o: The TDP government (2014-18) balanced its NDA alliance against the SCS demand
The AP government of 2024-26 sought project money for Amaravati, Polavaram and SASCI
YSRCP made SCS its 2019 campaign plank
The AP government of 2024-26 left the NDA to demand SCS
new.x: The AP government of 2024-26 was an NDA ally seeking project money, not one that left the NDA over SCS.

new.s: The revenue deficit grant of Rs 3,979 crore to Andhra Pradesh relates to:
new.x: Rs 3,979 crore was the 2014-15 revenue deficit grant; Rs 4,058.04 crore was the 2016-17 special assistance.

new.s: The Scheme for Special Assistance to States for Capital Investment (SASCI) is run by:
new.x: SASCI is run by the Ministry of Finance and began in October 2020.

new.s: SASCI loans to States lie outside which deficit ceiling?
new.x: SASCI loans are above the net borrowing ceiling and outside the 3% of GSDP limit.

new.s: Under SASCI, Andhra Pradesh can get up to how much in 2026-27?
new.x: AP can get up to Rs 8,226 crore under SASCI in 2026-27; Rs 7,900 crore and Rs 8,255 crore were the 2024-25 and 2025-26 loans.

new.s: In August 2026, the Centre gave an in-principle nod for which project in Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: The Rayalaseema Global Horticulture Hub (Centre Rs 10,000 crore + State Rs 30,000 crore) got an in-principle nod in August 2026.
